Today, the Lowcountry community came together to celebrate the life of fallen Charleston County Deputy Michael Hendricks, who was killed while on duty.

The community gathered for a police escort to guide Deputy Hendricks to his celebration of life ceremony in Summerville.

We are praying for his family, friends, fellow deputies, and loved ones during this difficult time. May he rest in peace, and may we never forget his sacrifice and service to our community.

MAHA means getting back to real food. Americans shouldn't need a chemistry degree to know what they're eating.
